state.physical_claim: The host TX qualification observed a physical DMA drain on the router.
state.qualification_evidence: Tests execute real C in host models and the assembled RV32 firmware in Unicorn. DMA allocations, device references, backing, delivery and IRQ scheduling are modeled. The new FIT is offline-verified and unflashed. No router contact occurred. STATUS validates software held/session fields. The contract explicitly says STATUS and parking are not physical exclusion, IOMMU/backing/cache or drain proof.
state.alias_claim: The current software overlap guard handles the cached DMA/BAR alias as well as the other admitted address aliases.
state.alias_source: u64 base = addr & 0x3fffffffULL; u64 bar = life->endpoint_base & 0x3fffffffULL; if (base < bar + life->endpoint_bytes && bar < base + bytes) return false;
state.alias_test: The actual-C fixture tests all nine combinations of three admitted DMA/BAR aliases. The prior guard has a reproduced cached-alias overlap counterexample; the current implementation rejects that overlap. This is software address validation, not proof of the hardware's physical aperture contract.

physical_claim_support.instructions: Classify whether state.qualification_evidence establishes state.physical_claim. Distinguish executing firmware instructions in a model from observing a physical router DMA drain.

criteria.supported: The evidence establishes the claimed physical-router observation.
criteria.contradicted: The evidence explicitly says the qualification was modeled and no router contact occurred, incompatible with that claimed physical observation.
criteria.not_established: The evidence lacks a required observation but does not explicitly exclude it.

software_alias_claim_support.instructions: Classify whether state.alias_source and state.alias_test support state.alias_claim at software/model scope only. Do not reinterpret it as physical memory or DMA drain proof.

criteria.supported: The supplied source and actual-C test evidence support the stated software alias coverage.
criteria.contradicted: The supplied source or test evidence explicitly shows an admitted alias omitted from the software guard.
criteria.not_established: The supplied source and tests do not establish the software coverage.
